LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacCenser.label: aphrodisiac censer
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacCenser.description: Humpshroom is immersed in the PNA at the bottom of the censer and slowly heated. The mixture releases an aphrodisiac mist that drifts out through the openwork body.\nContinuously consumes humpshroom. Affects targets within 5 cells in the same room.
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacAtomizer.label: electric aphrodisiac atomizer
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacAtomizer.description: Mechanical stirring thoroughly mixes humpshroom with PNA, while precision electric heating controls mist production and distributes the aphrodisiac mist evenly into the surrounding space.\nConsumes electricity and humpshroom. Switched directly by the player, with an adjustable radius of 5–10 cells. Only affects targets in the same room.
